messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "94% after 8 weeks"
set: ["94% after 8 weeks", "97% after 8 weeks", "87% after 4 weeks", "4 weeks after starting", "blood tests usually done 6 to 8 weeks after any dose change", "8 mg orally every 8 hours after the first dose", "use within 8 weeks of opening bottle", "4 weeks after each dose change", "efficacy beyond 8 weeks has not been systematically studied", "given for up to 8 weeks while esophagus heals", "8 mg", "20.9% or 48.6 lb after 72 weeks", "reassess blood pressure after a few weeks", "additional 8 weeks may be considered for patients who have not healed after the initial treatment", "do not take after 30 weeks of pregnancy", "effective contraception for two weeks after final dose"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
